lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 明天是我的生日。你来我家吃饭吗？
lines.pinyin: Míngtiān shì wǒ de shēngrì. Nǐ lái wǒ jiā chīfàn ma?
lines.english: Tomorrow is my birthday. Will you come to my house for dinner?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 当然来！生日快乐！我给你买了礼物。
lines.pinyin: Dāngrán lái! Shēngrì kuàilè! Wǒ gěi nǐ mǎile lǐwù.
lines.english: Of course! Happy birthday! I bought you a gift.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 是一本汉语书。很好看，适合你。
lines.pinyin: Shì yī běn Hànyǔ shū. Hěn hǎokàn, shìhé nǐ.
lines.english: It's a Chinese book. Very nice, suitable for you.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 太好了！我正想买一本新书呢。
lines.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Wǒ zhèng xiǎng mǎi yī běn xīnshū ne.
lines.english: Great! I was just wanting to buy a new book.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 我妈妈做了生日蛋糕。很好吃。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ māma zuòle shēngrì dàngāo. Hěn hǎochī.
lines.english: My mom made a birthday cake. It's delicious.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 那我们一起吃蛋糕、喝果汁吧。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒmen yīqǐ chī dàngāo, hē guǒzhī ba.
lines.english: Then let's eat cake and drink juice together.
